modes.name: creator
modes.about: Say what you want; the desk agent designs the room or the page

presets.name: discussion
presets.scenario: A discussion. Each speaker answers the question on the table from their own part, in a few sentences, and may disagree with the others.

presets.name: board
presets.scenario: A shared board of notes. Each speaker adds or corrects one item, then shows the whole board as a short list.

presets.name: game
presets.scenario: A game of tic-tac-toe on a 3x3 grid. The first seat plays X, the second O. On your turn, make one legal move, show the grid, and say if the game is won or drawn.
